args.title: Hotfix deployment: checkout-api v2.3.2 to all production regions

trace.final:
Done — here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Pre-check:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions, which was **unhealthy** with an 18% error rate — confirming the hotfix was needed. Deployment history showed v2.3.2 had never been released, so per policy it required change-manager approval before shipping.
2. **Approval:** Change-manager approved the deploy ("Approved. Looks right.").
3. **Deploy:** v2.3.2 rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-deploy check confirms the service is **healthy** with an error rate of 0.2% across all regions (down from 18%).
4. **Incident:** Opened SEV3 incident **INC-0001** to record the change (on-call paged), including the approval, rollout scope, and post-deploy verification details.
